Life at Demostack

Perks

  1. Competitive pay, great benefits, and equity options

    We offer every full-time employee competitive salary, health benefits, meaningful equity, and a retirement plan.

  2. Impact

    We move quickly and encourage every employee to push the envelope. Our best ideas come from out-of-the-box thinking and innovation! We want to hear your ideas.

  3. Inclusive and supportive environment

    You don't have to have the perfect background or credentials. We look for the right energy, ambition, and all around culture fit.

  4. Generous vacation policy

    We believe a good work-life balance is crucial to our happiness and productivity, which is why we take vacation very seriously.

  5. Team building

    We believe in getting to know your coworkers outside of work - so you can strengthen connections, gain new perspectives, and foster creativity.
